notes.title: Patch Notes Compilations Since Release
notes.notes:
As you may have noticed there has been a rapid fire of patches, bug fixes, and balance changes since release and I figure it would be nice to have the key notes in one place. These changes are driven by your feedback, so thank you and have a great day.

Red Barrels are more explosive, dark gods have given about 20% more ammo per pack
Made key item in house clearer to find
While crouching, a crouch will appear in the bottom right
Game now properly pauses
Game Timer, end game rankings, and new achievement added for Nightmare mode
Two more ammo packs added to normal mode to make it less oppressive
Fixed static meshes clipping throughout map
Increased flashlights ranges by 15 to 33 percent
Optimizations, Optimizations, Optimizations

notes.title: More Patch Notes 18 Feb
notes.notes: Fixed some wall clipping issues in tunnel

notes.title: Patch Notes 18 FEB
notes.notes:
Happy weekend! This patch is mostly clipping issues and a small balance fix.

Added two more ammo pack to normal mode to make that mode less oppressive
Fixed fence clipping and house mesh seam, fixed other misc. clipping issues
Increased flashlights ranges from 15 to 33 percent
Removed epic preset. Barely increases visual quality with a huge performance penalty.

notes.title: another another patch 13 Feb
notes.notes: HUGE optimizations to certain areas of the map

notes.title: Another Patch for 13 Feb
notes.notes: Popular request, crouching now has an icon that shows up.

notes.title: Patch Notes 13 FEB
notes.notes: The dark gods have looked favorably on you and have given you extra ammo, but have also made red barrels stronger. Also made 1 key item a little bit easier to find.
